articles.title: Gamescom Just Became the World's Biggest Gaming Event — and It's Not Feeling the Pressure
articles.summary: Gamescom is now the biggest gaming event on Earth, and it's staying cool about it. This year they're adding the speedrunning marathon Games Done Quick — its first time outside North America!

articles.title: The Author of 'Silo' Made Another Sci-Fi Show You Probably Missed — and It's Worth Finding
articles.summary: Hugh Howey, the author behind 'Silo,' also created 'Beacon 23,' a space-lighthouse drama starring Lena Headey and Stephan James. It only lasted two seasons, but it's a hidden gem for sci-fi fans.

articles.title: Martin Short's Triple-Threat Emmy Season: Home Movies, Grief, and a Little Bit of Betamax
articles.summary: Martin Short is nominated for three Emmys this year—for acting, hosting, and a documentary about his life. He even let the director use his old home movies, and Steven Spielberg chipped in too. He jokes, 'I am Mr. Emmy this year!'
